items.title: Ruthie Foster interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 28, 2023
items.q: The transcript only shows Monk Rowe introducing himself as the interviewer; no personal or professional relationship between Ruthie Foster and Monk Rowe is described.

ctx.x: Ruthie was interviewed via Zoom on February 28, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive, and I’m very pleased to have Ruthie Foster with me. Thank you for your time and congratulations on your career.
Well thank you. I’m happy to be here, I really am.
